scope: Internal research provenance for independent SDR examples. No upstream component code, branding or service claims are copied into public documentation.

references.adaptation: Single-page field ordering, cardholder name, expiry and plain-language security-code label; SDR-only test-card simulation, hosted provider guidance for production.
Labelled tel field, tel autocomplete, flexible input without masking and an explanation of contact purpose.
Text one-time-code field, numeric keyboard, clear resend/help context; fixed test code and no real SMS.
Planned maintenance with known example availability and a support route.
Plain missing-page explanation, address check and recovery links without blame or technical error jargon.
Unexpected submission failure with an explicit outcome, retry and support links; distinct from maintenance.
Separate account creation from sign-in, explain account need, permit password managers and avoid duplicate entry.
Application reference, concrete next steps and response timeframe.
